criteria.evidence:
Nine-clause criterion. Six clauses verified as satisfied in code by me; three are not proven, and the three gates that would corroborate them govern an empty or near-empty population.

SATISFIED, each read at head:
* ORGANIZATION-SCOPED OBJECT KEYS - the region-prefix cross-tenant defect the ticket found IS fixed at head. src/modules/storage/storage-key.ts:72-90 adds the region-prefixed branch ('if (second === callerOrgId || UUID_PATTERN.test(second)) return { ownerOrgId: second, folderRoot: segments[2] ?? "" }'), with a 40-line comment recording that reading segment one only reported the prefix as the folder root and disabled BOTH isForeignOrgKey and the SENSITIVE_FOLDER_ROOTS denial. src/modules/storage/storage-key-region-prefix.spec.ts exists (4,351 bytes).
* NAME SANITIZATION - sanitizeFileName / sanitizeFolder in storage-key.ts; single-segment folder, basename after both separators, restricted charset.
* IDEMPOTENT MULTIPART COMPLETION - storage-multipart.controller.ts:133-201 keys on uploadId and returns replayed; check:conflict-targets exit 0 at head confirms the ON CONFLICT arbiter is inferable and storage is clean.
* MALWARE QUARANTINE - file-quarantine.service.ts state machine (begin/markClean/markInfected/markError/softDelete/listForSweep), consulted by assertKeyReadable before minting. CAVEAT: isKeyBlocked returns false when no quarantine row exists - fail-open for untracked keys.
* BOUNDED ASYNC JOBS - src/modules/storage/media-transform.runner.ts:22-24: MAX_CONCURRENT = 2, MAX_QUEUED = 32, JOB_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000. Bounded on both axes plus a timeout; hasCapacity() is checked before the scan and refuses with 503 rather than queueing.
* CLEANUP MACHINERY - deleteFileIfPresent, storage-purge.service.ts purgeOrgPrefix, storage-pending-purge.service.ts (listForRetry/markConfirmed/markFailed - a durable deletion ledger), gdpr-storage-purge.service.ts (buildManifest/purgeFromManifest/hasActiveLegalHold).

NOT PROVEN - the failing clauses:
(a) 'AUTHORIZATION RECHECK BEFORE SHORT-LIVED DOWNLOAD URLS'. StorageService.getFileUrl is a bare minting primitive with no authorization of its own, so safety rests entirely on every caller. I enumerated the call sites at head: `grep -rn 'getFileUrl(' src/ --include='*.ts' | grep -v '.spec.ts'` -> 14 sites, and 11 of them are OUTSIDE src/modules/storage/**: chat-attachments.service.ts, support/core/support-kb-engagement.service.ts, four HR controllers (hr-onboarding-docs-admin, exit, onboarding-views, performance/documents), payroll/payout/payout-batches.service.ts, and three e-sign services (sign-public, sign-finalization x2, sign-documents). The ticket's own report states plainly 'The remaining 12 minting sites are outside my territory and I did not verify them.' Nobody has. I spot-checked two and both DO bind before minting (chat-attachments.service.ts:25-42 selects the attachment under eq(chatAttachments.orgId, orgId) AND eq(chatMessages.orgId, orgId) before getFileUrl; e-sign/sign-public.service.ts:171-178 goes through withRecipientSession(token) and binds documentId to envelope.id) - but nine remain unaudited, including the two other e-sign minting sites on a public envelope path.
(b) 'WITHOUT ... EXPOSING PUBLIC URLS' - the gate that would prove it cannot fail. check:public-object-urls exit 0, full output: 'public-base references 9 (9 declared) / upload-result url fields 0' followed by SKIP lines for every one. Its enforceable scope is ZERO sites, so a green here is not evidence.
(c) 'GDPR/RETENTION DELETION MUST CLEAN DATABASE ROWS AND OBJECTS' at schema scope - check:retention-coverage exit 0 over 14 of 944 tables. Its population is 'tables over 1 MB on the connected database', so table size there is a function of seed data, not of production growth; 930 tables carry no retention decision and are invisible to it.

TWO FURTHER CLAUSES ARE CONDITIONAL, not clean:
* 'VALIDATE ... MAGIC-BYTE MIME' - src/modules/storage/file-signatures.ts ends `const signatures = FILE_SIGNATURES[mimeType]; if (!signatures) return true;` - an unknown MIME passes unconditionally. Not exploitable today only because the nine-entry ALLOWED_UPLOAD_TYPES allowlist happens to have a signature for every entry. It becomes a hole the moment a caller adds an allowlist entry without a signature.
* 'ONE TENANT-PRIVATE UPLOAD INTERFACE' - true in code (no S3 command outside the storage module except the operator script setup-r2-buckets.ts), but the gate named for it covers none of the real path: check:multipart-contracts prints 'scanned 551 controller file(s) ... OK - every handler with a file interceptor carries @MultipartAction or @BodylessAction' and never names the governed count. I counted it: 8 files reference FileInterceptor/FilesInterceptor outside specs, and src/modules/storage/storage-multipart.controller.ts (:68 initiate, :133 complete, :204 abort) - the presigned multipart path - has NO interceptor, so the gate governs zero of the surface it is named for.

SEPARATE CROSS-TENANT PERFORMANCE/AUTHORIZATION HAZARD, confirmed at head and not fixed: src/modules/storage/storage.controller.ts:383-390 - resolveFileOwner runs SEVEN concurrent leading-wildcard `ilike(<col>, like)` queries (documents, onboardingDocuments, expenses, reimbursements, handbookVersions, payslipPublications, candidateDocumentsVault) on EVERY download, in the authorization path, and CLAUDE.md bans leading-wildcard ILIKE outright. None of the seven carries an orgId predicate; they rely on RLS, so under the owner role they are unfiltered.
criteria.blocker: The 'authorization recheck before short-lived download URLs' clause is unverified at 11 of the 14 getFileUrl minting sites (9 still unaudited by anyone, including two e-sign sites reachable from a public envelope path), and the three gates that would corroborate the public-URL, one-interface and retention clauses each report OK over an enforced population of zero (public-object-urls: 9/9 declared), zero-of-the-real-path (multipart-contracts) and 14 of 944 tables (retention-coverage). Closing needs an audit of the 9 remaining minting sites and a governed-count line on those three gates.
criteria.clauses_failing: 'authorization recheck before short-lived download URLs' (11 of 14 minting sites outside the audited seam, 9 unaudited); 'without orphaning or exposing public URLs' (check:public-object-urls has 0 enforceable sites); 'GDPR/retention deletion' at schema scope (check:retention-coverage sees 14 of 944 tables). Conditional: magic-byte validation fails open for any MIME absent from FILE_SIGNATURES; quarantine fails open for untracked keys. Holding: org-scoped keys (defect found and fixed at storage-key.ts:72-90), name sanitization, idempotent multipart completion, bounded transforms, cleanup machinery.
